Factors Affecting Risk of CVD Events in a Global CVD Prevention Cohort of People with HIV. PWH face increased risks of major adverse cardiovascular disease (MACE), partially mitigated by statin therapy. We characterized factors associated with MACE and MACE subcomponents among a global cohort of PWH in REPRIEVE. Our primary outcome measure was time-to-first primary MACE.
